module: Flowgraph node "Multi Graph" (category repeat_instant, tags util/draw/table/data). Plots several curves in the same graph in the node body: one number input pin (value1, value2...) per curve, their count is set by data.count. Keeps the last 400 values per curve; the scale (data.scaleMin/scaleMax) grows automatically with the values.
notes: A game comment flags "TODO: fix invalid C type error" on the im.PlotMultiLines call.
The series are indexed by the pairs() order over the pins, so the order of the curves is not guaranteed.

init.desc: Initializes data tables, 400 points max, count = 1, scale 0..1.

work.desc: Adds the numeric value of each pin to its series, extends the scale, removes the oldest values beyond the max size.

resetGraphData.desc: Rebuilds labels, rainbow colors and series from the connected numeric pins.

updatePins.desc: Adds or removes value<i> pins to go from old to new (removes the links of removed pins), then resets the data.

new.desc: new number of pins (rounded up, minimum 0)

_onDeserialized.desc: Recreates the pins according to data.count.

drawMiddle.desc: Editor: synchronizes the number of pins with data.count and draws the curves (PlotMultiLines).
